resources.string: The text you are writing is never sent to the server for a link preview — previews appear only after the message is sent.
Chat search shows local results only; your queries never reach Telegram\'s servers.
The AI text editor and message summaries are turned off — no AI requests ever leave the device.
Tracking parameters (utm, gclid, fbclid, …) are removed from links before they are opened in the browser.
